capabilities: Toggle plugins on or off from a sortable table with change timestamps
Set per-plugin delayed startup in seconds
Disable plugins per device type (phone, tablet, desktop)
Attach Markdown notes with internal links to plugins
Save and restore enabled states, device rules, delays, and notes
extras: UI and documentation are bilingual (Chinese/English); installation is manual via cloning and building the repository.
problem: Obsidian's community plugins settings give no overview table, no delayed startup, no per-device rules, and no way to snapshot states while troubleshooting conflicts.
summary: Plugin manager that adds a sortable table to toggle, delay-start, restrict by device type, annotate, and back up installed plugins.
